# General community composition
## Integrated by station
```{r}
commun <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, taxagroup) %>% 
  summarise(nimgs = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta, by = "sample_id") %>% 
  arrange(object_date)

ggplot(commun, aes(x = sample_id, y = nimgs, fill = taxagroup)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c25) 

commun <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta, by = "sample_id") %>% 
  mutate(YearMonth = paste(Year, Month)) %>% 
  group_by(YearMonth, taxagroup) %>% 
  summarise(nimgs = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(commun, aes(x = YearMonth, y = nimgs, fill = taxagroup)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c25) 

```

## Depth distribution for 2021 and 2023 data
Update this when Ecopart for 2024 is available...
These may not be very useful for now because it is based on abundance and not biovolume/biomass
```{r}
# cope_carbon_2024
binsize <-  100
uvp6_ecopartBin <- Ecopart_UVP6 %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin) %>% 
  summarise(volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            nbins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(binsize = binsize) %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = paste0(depthBin,"m-",depthBin+binsize,"m"))
uvp6_ecopartBin <- uvp6_ecopartBin %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = factor(depthRange,
                             levels = unique(uvp6_ecopartBin$depthRange)))

# Total Abundance
commun_dep_totalAbund <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  filter(sample_cruise %in% c("darkedge", "amundsen2023")) %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(object_date),
         Month = month(object_date),
         DOY = yday(object_date)) %>% 
  
  # Add the total volume for the depth bin
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  select(-c(Sampled_volume_m3)) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_ecopartBin,
            by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate total abundance by depth bin
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin, 
           object_lon, object_lat, Year, Month, DOY, volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance / volume_m3) %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = paste0(depthBin,"m-",depthBin+binsize,"m"))
commun_dep_totalAbund <- commun_dep_totalAbund %>% 
  filter(object_lat > 63) %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = factor(depthRange,
                             levels = unique(commun_dep_totalAbund$depthRange)))


ggplot(commun_dep_totalAbund, aes(y = abundance_m3,
                                  x = depthRange)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 4, outlier.size = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Abundance (indivs /m3)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  facet_wrap(~Month)


# Average abundance composition
commun_dep_taxagroups <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  filter(sample_cruise %in% c("darkedge", "amundsen2023")) %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(object_date),
         Month = month(object_date),
         DOY = yday(object_date)) %>% 
  
  # Add the total volume for the depth bin
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  select(-c(Sampled_volume_m3)) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_ecopartBin,
            by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate total abundance by depth bin
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin, taxagroup,
           object_lon, object_lat, Year, Month, DOY, volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance / volume_m3) %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = paste0(depthBin,"m-",depthBin+binsize,"m"))

commun_dep_taxagroups <- commun_dep_taxagroups %>% 
  filter(taxagroup == "Copepoda") %>% 
  filter(object_lat > 63) %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = factor(depthRange,
                             levels = unique(commun_dep_taxagroups$depthRange)))


ggplot(commun_dep_taxagroups, aes(y = abundance_m3,
                                  x = depthRange)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 4, outlier.size = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Abundance (indivs /m3)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  facet_wrap(~Month)

```


# Morphotrait space
TODO: need to curate taxa that get included, especially when there are large images for gelatinous taxa
```{r}
uvp.morpho <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  filter(taxagroup %in% c("Copepoda","Copepoda-lipidsac")) %>% 
  select(object_id,
         Major = object_major, Minor = object_minor, Perim. = object_perim.,
         Feret = object_feret, Area = object_area, Elongation = object_elongation,
         Ver.Sym. = object_symetriev, Ver.Sym.2 = object_symetrievc, 
         Circ. = object_circ., Thickr = object_thickr, 
         Mean.grey = object_mean, Med.grey = object_median,
         `Hist.grey 75%` = object_histcum3, 
         Sdev.grey = object_stddev, Skew.grey = object_skew,
         Fractal = object_fractal, 
         `Perim./Feret` = object_perimferet,
         `Perim./Major` = object_perimmajor) %>% 
  remove_rownames() %>% 
  column_to_rownames("object_id")


pca <- FactoMineR::PCA(as.matrix(scale(uvp.morpho)), graph = FALSE)
# Note can weigh rows based on concentration

plot(pca, label = "var")
plot(pca, choix="var", axes = c(1,2))
plot(pca, choix="var", axes = c(3,4))

summary(pca)

# selection of axis :
kaiser_guttman(pca)

```
